[[Taskmaster Durgon]] is a [[Stone Summit]] [[boss]] that appears on the first level of [[Vloxen Excavations]], east of the exit to [[Vlox's Falls]]. He must be defeated to obtain the [[Boss Key]].

== Locations ==
* [[Depths of Tyria]]
** {{NPC location|Vloxen Excavations}} (during the following [[quest]])

== Quests ==
* [[Depths of Tyria]]
** [[Dredging the Depths]]

* {{Skill icon|Endure Pain}}
* {{Skill icon|Enraging Charge}}
* {{Skill icon|Healing Signet}}
* {{Skill icon|Staggering Blow}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Durgon's Maul]] ([[unique]])
* [[Dwarven Armor]]
* [[Stone Summit Emblem]]
* [[Stone Summit Shield]]

== Notes ==
{{Bug|Sometimes Durgon spawns with a shield and axe, while still holding these like a hammer. However, he cannot use his hammer requiring skills.}}
